messages.author: 509d884113938f54
messages.subject: RStan for R-2.15.2
parts:
I am at the University of Alaska, Fairbanks.  A gentleman at the Arctic Region Supercomputing Center (ARSC) is installing Rstan for me onto their Pacman cluster.  In the process he found that it looks like RStan is not yet available for R-2.15.2.  When might Rstan be updated for R-2.15.2?

If Rstan will not be updated for R-2.15.2 for a while, ARSC is willing install Rstan and its dependencies for R-2.15.1.

Thank you,

Mark

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: RStan for R-2.15.2
parts:
RStan is generally not tied to R releases. I'm not aware of any reason why RStan can't be installed on R 2.15.2; in fact, I have done so several times (but only on Linux). The only restriction that I know of is that RStan depends on  Rcpp 0.9.10 or later which in turn requires R 2.15.1 or later.

Ben
